scientific_question: Can the 124M dense c_proj trajectory be reproduced on idle PRO6 with the same optimizer, data, seeds, schedule, snapshot protocol, and fixed evaluation identity so the bilateral endpoint task oracle can proceed without interfering with the unrelated Y400 workload?
reason_for_replay: Y400 GPUs 0-3 are occupied by another user's four-GPU GSM8K evaluation projected to run for hours; the 12 GiB local-routed copy measured only about 0.13 MiB/s and was stopped after 4.5 MiB.

performance_gate.protocol: real training preflight with one warmup and eight timed updates, empirical local BF16 GEMM denominator, and parameter-trajectory diagnostic I/O retained and charged to iteration time

training_execution.authorization: one exact directly polled 238-update dense trajectory replay only after the MFU gate passes

acceptance.preflight: measured MFU >=0.20, all timed losses finite, diagnostic snapshots present, and no other GPU process
acceptance.trajectory: clean terminal evaluation at update 238, 239 snapshots from step 0 through 238, exact runtime dataset/eval digest, finite losses, and complete checkpoint/provenance metadata
acceptance.cross_host_comparison: PRO6 need not be bitwise equal to Y400, but all semantic config, data, RNG, schedule, evaluation, and snapshot identities must match; record any terminal CE difference before using the replay internally.

authorization_after_acceptance: Apply the already frozen bilateral endpoint CE rule to this replay's own checkpoint and snapshots. No production bilateral implementation or language-model candidate training is authorized by the trajectory replay itself.
